compute_correlated_equilibrium_best_resp: compute the correlated equilibrium best response for a mean-field game given policies, weights, and state distributions
compute_joint_best_response: compute the joint best response policy and value for a mean-field game with given state distributions and temporal weights
compute_mean_field_rewards: compute the reward matrix for a list of policies across a set of state distributions in a mean-field game
compute_correlated_equilibrium_gap: compute the correlated equilibrium gap to measure exploitability of a policy profile in a mean-field game
compute_average_welfare: compute the average welfare across policies, state distributions, temporal weights, and policy distributions in a mean-field game
